meta.name: Crossroads
meta.description: Crossroads depicts university life in 1990s Nigeria, focusing on Eriola, Oyekan, and Fela. Eriola faces family pressure, Oyekan's gang adds tension, and Eriola confronts false accusations with friends' support. Threats from Don Smart loom as Fela attempts to shield Eriola, leading to emotional confrontations.
